Dear Interledgerians,

We at openDemocracy are experimenting with new incentives for constructive participation on media articles: the best comments get highlighted and share payments. It’s just another application of Interledger based monetization.

I see this very much as part of wider trends around the race to establish digital money standards so we are encouraging this debate on our platform.

The best comments will receive payments if highlighted on participating articles, so please share your opinions.

Invoking your insights,
